mapper.sql: select l.log_id, l.order_no, l.user_id, l.user_name, l.pay_method, l.amount, l.items, l.result, l.reason, l.create_time from pet_payment_log l
mapper.insert: insert into pet_payment_log (order_no, user_id, user_name, pay_method, amount, items, result, reason, create_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{payMethod}, #{amount}, #{items}, #{result}, #{reason}, sysdate())
mapper.select: where l.order_no = #{orderNo} order by l.log_id desc limit 1

select count(distinct case when c.status <> '3' then c.order_no end) as totalOrders, count(distinct case when c.status <> '3' and c.pay_status = '1' then c.order_no end) as paidOrders, ifnull(sum(case when c.status <> '3' and c.pay_status = '1' then c.amount else 0 end), 0) as paidAmount, count(distinct case when c.status <> '3' and (c.pay_status is null or c.pay_status = '0') then c.order_no end) as unpaidOrders, ifnull(sum(case when c.status <> '3' and (c.pay_status is null or c.pay_status = '0') then c.amount else 0 end), 0) as unpaidAmount, count(distinct case when c.status <> '3' and (c.pay_status is null or c.pay_status = '0') and exists (select 1 from pet_payment_log l where l.order_no = c.order_no and l.result = 'fail') then c.order_no end) as failOrders, count(distinct case when c.status = '3' then c.order_no end) as canceledOrders, ifnull(sum(case when c.status = '3' then c.amount else 0 end), 0) as canceledAmount from pet_cart c where c.order_no is not null and c.order_no <> ''

select date(l.create_time) as day, count(case when l.result = 'success' then 1 end) as okCount, count(case when l.result = 'fail' then 1 end) as failCount, ifnull(sum(case when l.result = 'success' then l.amount else 0 end), 0) as okAmount from pet_payment_log l where l.create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date(l.create_time) order by day
